identification: Framed hand-coloured steel engraving 'Van Diemen's Island or Tasmania', John Tallis & Co (drawn/engraved J. Rapkin, views by H. Warren / J. Rogers), the c.1851 Illustrated Atlas map: vignettes of Hobart Town (top), Government House-type building (lower left), thylacine (lower right), medallion at left, Greek-key and leaf border with the border coloured (later colour likely; originals usually have outline colour only). In a gilt composition frame with black mount, 60 x 48 cm overall per catalogue. Original vs good facsimile NOT settled by the photos: the imprint is the 1851 'London & New York' one, but facsimiles copy it. Visible brown tide-line stains across central and western Tasmania.

viewing_check: Take it out of the glare: look for a plate mark around the image, laid/wove paper toning, and under a loupe no halftone dots (facsimiles show dot screen). Check the stains are on the paper (not the glass/mount), and the back of the frame for age. Only worth a bid at the Armitage estimate (A$60-90) if you want it for the wall.
